facts.label: How much e comparativos
facts.sub: Pergunte How much is/are…? e compare com adjetivo-er + than ou more + adjetivo: The white cheese is cheaper than the yellow cheese.

facts.label: Quanto
facts.sub: Para perguntar o preço, use How much is…? com uma coisa e How much are…? com várias: How much is the honey? How much are the strawberries? A resposta é It is ten dollars.

facts.label: Mais barato
facts.sub: Para comparar preços, junte -er ao adjetivo curto e use than: cheaper than, bigger than. Diga The white cheese is cheaper than the yellow cheese. Não diga more cheap.

We say “How much cost the honey?” → Falso (We say How much is the honey?)
Cheaper is the comparative of cheap. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: At the market square · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy Saturday in Halifax. People fill the old market square. Colorful stalls sell honey, cheese and strawberries. Wendy stands behind her stall with a basket. Marco walks up with a smile. She says hello.
“Hello! Can I help you?” says Wendy. “Yes, please. How much is the honey?” says Marco. “A small jar is six dollars. A big jar is ten dollars.” says Wendy.
